meta_description: 56 likes, 4 comments - engadget on October 28, 2026: "The Edge feels like the first successful attempt in Fitbit’s history to deliver a good-looking yet minimal activity tracker, thanks not only to solid hardware but an easy-to-use and fairly refined operating system. With the Fitbit Edge and Fitbit Air, it feels like Fitbit is back to reclaim the activity tracker space that it became synonymous with.".
